title: Structural balance in signed digraphs: considering transitivity to measure balance in graphs constructed by using different link signing methods
reasoning: The paper's methodology is centrally focused on evaluating structural balance in networks where the relationships are defined by moral values. It explicitly uses Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) and a Moral Foundation Dictionary (MFD) to label communication links (edges) with signs representing virtue (+) or vice (-). This analysis of network structure through the lens of morality is a core component of the research, not a peripheral discussion.
